page.overview:
Who is Phaedrine?

She is lean and small-boned, with dark hair and brown eyes. Much like the Brown Ajah stereotype, she tends to allow her low quality clothing to fall into disrepair, with tears and stains. She might be considered pretty if not for how much she frowns.

Phaedrine is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . We know of only a handful of Aes Sedai that are weaker. She is the same strength as Siuan Sanche after Siuan was Healed from stilling.

Although she is not strong enough to Travel, she and Shemari linked together were just strong enough to make a barely usable gateway.

She is allied with the Salidar Aes Sedai.
